title: The whole MetroPT-3 recording
notes: The MetroPT-3 check: all four headline failures against seven months of negative time, from the whole CSV rather than from a slice, so it needs METROPT_CSV and runs only in the full profile. It is recorded as in-sample — the windows it is scored on are the windows the detector was tuned against — so it sits in the dev split and reports rather than gates. The false-ticket budget is one per machine-day over the 213 days of the recording; the figure the report carries is tickets per machine-day, not this bound.
